title: READ-005: Improve variable naming in buildQuery
description: The buildQuery function uses abbreviated variable names (q, k, v) that are unclear. Using full names (queryString, key, value) improves code readability without any functional impact.

context.current_code:
const q = Object.entries(params)
  .filter(([, v]) => v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '' && v !== 0)
  .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(v)}`)
  .join('&')
return q ? `?${q}` : ''
context.issue: Single-letter variable names are unclear and hard to reason about

acceptance_criteria: Underscore '_' renamed to meaningful name (if needed) or left as-is for unused params

implementation_notes.underscore_note: Use '_' for intentionally unused 'key' in filter callback (convention), or use full name if clearer

code_review: Verify variable names are clear and meaningful
Check no regressions in buildQuery behavior
functional_test: Test buildQuery with various param combinations
Verify query string is correctly formatted

rollback_plan: git revert <commit-hash> — simple rename, safe to revert
notes: This is a quick naming improvement with minimal effort. It's the smallest task (5 min) and can be batched with other refactoring work. No functional changes; pure readability improvement.
